title: SWIMMING  a
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the first step of becoming a swimming coach. 6."
Knowing how to swim is the first step of becoming a swimming coach. 6.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a major cause of accidents, either by being run over by a boat or entanglement on climbing into a boat. b."
Propeller damage is a major cause of accidents, either by being run over by a boat or entanglement on climbing into a boat. b.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an alternating up and down kicking movement in water, starting from the hip."
The leg action is an alternating up and down kicking movement in water, starting from the hip.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the determining factor in floating."
A person's body size is the determining factor in floating.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the only start from the water."
Start The backstroke start is the only start from the water.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is considered in three stage and they are: Arm entering water, the pull push and the recovery."
The arm action is considered in three stage and they are: Arm entering water, the pull push and the recovery.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used mainly for training purposes. ii."
The stroke is used mainly for training purposes. ii.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the progression of a swimmer using fins either on the water surface or under water."
Finswimming is the progression of a swimmer using fins either on the water surface or under water.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the official swimming competitions according to the rules of FINA."
Freestyle swimming Freestyle is one of the official swimming competitions according to the rules of FINA.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the strokes in swimming."
Backstroke is one of the strokes in swimming.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the fastest and most efficient swimming technique."
The crawl is the fastest and most efficient swimming technique.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the diver with the highest total points scored in the final competition ix."
The winner is the diver with the highest total points scored in the final competition ix.

Water confidence

Front crawl

four competitive strokes
The four competitive strokes are the butterfly, backstroke, breaststroke, and freestyle (front crawl).

Swimming

leg kick
